purpose: full corrected-run memory and token validation; passive cache diagnostic, not promotion throughput

launch.note: Launch mistakenly set unused MTPLX_EXPERT_IO_FANOUT=4; MTPLX_DSV41_IO_READ_FANOUT was unset. Fanout defaults to1. Preserve raw data and do not compare timing to the clean fanout4 baseline.

replay.note: Must probe try_plan_all_hits before plan; hit touch order is part of installed recency behavior. Direct plan-only replay differed by4 misses.

limitations: Sampled peaks are not instantaneous upper bounds.
16K AR geometry only; native MTP and larger shapes require separate peak gates.
Policy comparisons keep the captured warm cache fixed and are offline screens, not whole-run speed measurements.
